column1: 紀實與街頭|Documentary & street|street-zone|廣角街頭區域對焦|Wide zone-focused street|28 mm 廣角配 f/8，預對焦，保留前中後景的關係|pre-focus a 28 mm field at f/8 and keep foreground, middle distance and background connected|以現場光保留偶然人物位置，不要求排演|work with available light and incidental placements rather than staging|日常行走與有敘事線索的場景

紀實與街頭|Documentary & street|street-tele|街頭長焦壓縮|Telephoto street compression|以 135 mm 從遠處對焦，壓近重複輪廓與軸線|work from farther away at 135 mm, compressing repeated outlines and aligned axes|保留高反差邊緣，讓無關細節離焦|retain strong edge separation while defocusing incidental detail|遠距層層疊影與街道結構

紀實與街頭|Documentary & street|mobile-candid|手機隨手紀錄|Candid phone documentary|以偏廣角原生視野和自然手持高度保留小幅擺動感|keep a slightly wide native phone field and a naturally imperfect handheld eye level|不用美肌、去噪塗抹或精心美化小瑕疵|avoid beauty smoothing, aggressive noise reduction and polished imperfections|生活紀錄與不擺拍的故事

紀實與街頭|Documentary & street|reportage|現場報導照|Available-light reportage|35 mm 自然視角，小幅欠曝保留現場重點|use a 35 mm natural field and slight underexposure to retain scene-critical highlight information|等待能交代空間和事件的瞬間，不刻意移動物件|wait for an informative instant without rearranging the location|事件環境與不干預記錄

紀實與街頭|Documentary & street|snapshot-flash|直打閃燈快照|Direct-flash snapshot|相機軸線直打小閃燈，主體明亮而背景迅速失光|fire a small on-axis flash into a bright subject with rapid background falloff|保留近距離硬影，讓框外黑暗不被補亮|preserve short hard shadows and leave the surroundings unfilled|夜間快照與粗糙現場反差

紀實與街頭|Documentary & street|monochrome-doc|黑白銀鹽紀實|Monochrome silver-grain documentary|以黑白銀鹽感的顆粒、暗部可讀的多階灰階呈現|favor monochrome silver-grain character, clear layered grays and readable shadows|讓場景重點靠明暗分離，不依賴色相|separate scene information through luminance, not color|街頭與具時間感的紀錄

光線控制|Lighting control|softbox|大型柔光箱|Large softbox exposure|把大面積光源靠近主體，讓陰影有柔和半影與可預測衰減|place a large modifier near the subject for soft penumbrae and predictable falloff|以黑板吸收少量雜光，保留形體|use a small negative fill to preserve form|人像、商品與平滑曲面

光線控制|Lighting control|rembrandt|三角側光|Rembrandt triangle lighting|把主光抬高並側移，讓陰面形成封閉三角光區|raise and offset the key so it creates a closed triangle of light on the shadow-facing plane|低比例回填，但保留清楚的亮暗分界|use little fill and retain a readable shadow boundary|立體表面及中高反差人像

光線控制|Lighting control|clamshell|上下柔光補亮|Clamshell lighting|上方柔光作主光，下方反光板抬起陰影|key with a soft source above and raise shadows using a reflector below|上光較亮，避免反向陰影或無形體的全平光|keep the upper source stronger and avoid reverse shadows or featureless flat light|美容、靜物與潔淨質感

光線控制|Lighting control|rim|輪廓背光|Edge-rim photography|從背側窄束加光，只描出外緣和半透明材質|add narrow rear-side light that traces outer edges and translucent material|保持正面比邊光低一到兩級而有細節|keep the front one to two stops lower while retaining detail|剪影分離與透明材質

光線控制|Lighting control|window-natural|單窗自然光|Single-window natural light|一側窗作唯一主光，逐步遠離窗面取得深暗背景|use one window as the key and move away from it to darken the background naturally|控制窗影，僅在需要時用白卡輕補|manage window shadows and use a white card only for slight fill|居家桌面與親密感敘事

光線控制|Lighting control|hard-gobo|硬光遮片投影|Hard gobo projection|單一硬光穿過遮片，在表面投下明確幾何陰影|send one hard source through a mask and project defined geometric shadows onto a surface|保留投影邊界，不用另外的霧面柔光抵消效果|keep projected shadow boundaries instead of canceling the effect with soft fill|構成圖、硬邊與建築投影

鏡頭與景深|Lenses & depth of field|portrait-85|中長焦淺景深|Fast short-telephoto separation|85 mm f/1.8，自然透視並讓背景離焦|use an 85 mm f/1.8 field for natural perspective and a blurred background|主閱讀面對焦，明顯保留前後景差|focus on the primary reading plane and keep foreground/background separation obvious|半身人像及重點取景

鏡頭與景深|Lenses & depth of field|macro-one|等倍微距|Life-size macro|100 mm 微距接近 1:1，展示通常看不見的微小紋理|work at close to 1:1 with a 100 mm macro lens to reveal ordinarily invisible texture|在焦平面上安排主細節，容許周邊自然離焦|align key detail with the focus plane and allow peripheral blur|質感、花蕊、飾品

鏡頭與景深|Lenses & depth of field|focus-stack|深焦堆疊|Depth-stacked close study|從近至遠多段補焦合成；微小表面仍清楚|merge controlled focus steps from near to far so small surfaces remain legible|不加入景深光圈不可能形成的重影|avoid double edges or implausible blur transitions between surfaces|結構展示、近距離細部

鏡頭與景深|Lenses & depth of field|tilt-shift|移軸校正攝影|Shift-corrected perspective|用移軸鏡頭水平對齊相機，保留垂直線不收斂|level the camera and shift the lens to preserve verticals without convergence|地平線與構圖分開控制，避免數位拉伸感|control horizon and framing separately and avoid a stretched digital look|建築、室內與垂直結構

鏡頭與景深|Lenses & depth of field|fisheye|魚眼曲面視角|Curved fisheye view|極廣魚眼讓畫面邊緣有明顯桶形彎曲|use an extreme fisheye with visible barrel curvature near the edges|關鍵主體保持在中央較少變形處|keep the critical subject near the less distorted center|包圍感空間與近距離視角

鏡頭與景深|Lenses & depth of field|split-diopter|雙焦面局部銳利|Split-diopter dual focus|在鏡頭半側加近攝片，使近景和遠景各有一平面清晰|place a diopter over half of the lens for separate near and far planes of sharpness|讓落差邊界落在暗部或形體邊緣|hide the transition at a dark seam or a form boundary|前後景並陳與不尋常的聚焦

底片與調色|Film & color treatment|color-negative|柔階彩負底片|Soft color-negative palette|以細粒彩負風格處理飽和度、柔和高光肩和中性灰|treat saturation with a fine-grained color-negative look, a soft highlight shoulder and neutral grays|保留天然材質，不用漂白黑位|retain natural surfaces rather than washing the blacks entirely|日常觀察與柔和色彩

底片與調色|Film & color treatment|reversal|高彩透明正片|High-chroma reversal color|正片感對比，中灰厚實，純色鮮明，高光準確|use slide-like contrast, solid midtones, vivid chroma and precise exposure|亮部臨界仍保留顏色，不過度抬黑|preserve hue close to highlights instead of lifting blacks|艷色風景與清楚色塊

底片與調色|Film & color treatment|instant-film|即影成像色移|Instant-print color shift|保留溫暖白點和陰影青綠色移，銳度輕微降低|retain a warm white point and cyan-green shadow shift with softly reduced sharpness|邊角密度稍有變化，不加品牌框或文字|vary corner density slightly without any branded border or print text|回憶碎片與小品紀錄

底片與調色|Film & color treatment|bleach-bypass|銀保留高反差|Bleach-bypass contrast|加深黑部並壓低多數色相飽和，保留亮部灰銀層次|deepen blacks and suppress most chroma with layered silvery highlights|中灰反差集中在紋理，而非全畫面過銳|concentrate midtone contrast on texture, not sharpening everywhere|粗礫材質和冷硬氣氛

底片與調色|Film & color treatment|infrared|遠紅外亮葉效果|Near-infrared tonal effect|以近紅外感的亮植被與暗天空建立反常亮度|render near-infrared-like bright vegetation and an unusually dark sky|正常保留硬物幾何，不套隨機假色|retain credible hard-object geometry instead of random false color|景物調性反轉與實驗視角

底片與調色|Film & color treatment|halation|暗背景高光暈影|Highlight halation at night|將高對比點光處理成小面積暖色暈影，黑位仍清楚|give intense point lights small warm halation fringes while keeping black values clear|餘下區域顆粒細微，不讓光暈蓋過邊緣|apply subtle grain elsewhere and keep halation off important edges|夜景光點、霓虹與反射

景物與空間|Landscape & space|long-exposure|腳架長曝流動|Tripod long-exposure flow|腳架穩定拍攝，以數秒曝光拉開流動水、細雲或人影|steady a tripod and use a multisecond exposure for flowing water, thin clouds or moving figures|靜止物邊線保持銳利，不讓整張失焦|keep stationary details crisp rather than blurring the entire image|有穩定錨點的流動場景

景物與空間|Landscape & space|golden-land|金時斜光風景|Golden-hour side light|低角度暖斜光穿過遠近層，暗面偏冷|rake warm low-angle light over near and far layers with cooler shaded planes|注意亮暗交界和疊層，使用自然光影而非橙色濾鏡|use natural highlight transitions and layering rather than a uniform orange filter|層次地貌、城市天際線

景物與空間|Landscape & space|overcast-arch|陰天質地觀察|Overcast architectural study|陰天的均勻光令材料顏色和少量接縫清楚|use even overcast light to make materials and small panel joints legible|保留鉛灰天空與深度梯度，不硬推反差|keep a leaden sky and depth gradients without forcing contrast|現代建築與材料調查

景物與空間|Landscape & space|bluehour|藍調時刻光色|Blue-hour mixed-light scene|以深藍環境和局部暖人造光形成色溫分區|contrast deep blue ambient light with local warm fixtures as distinct temperature regions|校正個別區域而非把整個畫面白平衡成一色|correct locally rather than forcing a single white balance across the whole scene|傍晚城市、海岸與室內外連接

景物與空間|Landscape & space|night-practicals|夜間現場燈光黑色電影感|Neo-noir practical lights|利用現場可見的小型燈具、深陰影與鏡面反光|motivate light from visible practical sources with deep shadows and specular reflections|至少保留一條可讀的主體亮邊，不用全景霓虹|keep a readable subject edge instead of saturating the whole scene with neon|夜間街景、車窗與低調室內

景物與空間|Landscape & space|panorama|多幅拼接全景|Stitched spatial panorama|用等曝光的相鄰視角組接，保留連續地平與原本大小關係|combine overlapping equal-exposure views into a continuous horizon with consistent relative scale|抑制明顯接縫、重複物件和不必要彎折|avoid visible seams, object duplication and unnecessary bending|連續空間和廣闊環境

靜物與生活|Still life & lifestyle|flatlay|垂直俯拍排版|Orthographic flat lay|鏡頭垂直向下，按使用關聯排出物件間距|aim straight downward and space objects by how they are used together|讓方形物件邊線平行於畫面，不做仿透視|align rectangular edges with the frame and avoid simulated oblique perspective|桌面用品、食物與設計清單

靜物與生活|Still life & lifestyle|product-clean|無縫背景型錄|Seamless product catalog|在無縫紙上鋪柔光，物體及其接觸影清楚|use soft fill on a seamless sweep with readable contact shadows under the object|保持材質色、不加場景雜物或漂浮懸空|preserve material color without props or unnatural floating|商品材質與形狀確認

靜物與生活|Still life & lifestyle|lifestyle|真實使用情境照|In-use lifestyle scene|把物件置入有具體用途的空間，呈現使用線索而不擺滿裝飾|place the object in a plausible setting and show how it is used without decorative clutter|以柔和局部光將事物和周圍材質聯繫|connect the subject and surrounding materials with soft local light|工作桌、居家物件與日常品牌

靜物與生活|Still life & lifestyle|food-side|食物側逆光|Back-side food photography|讓側逆光穿透薄邊，凸出油亮、水氣與表面凹凸|rake back-side light through thin edges to reveal sheen, vapor, and surface texture|控制反光不溢白，保留食材真實色|shape reflection without clipping and preserve honest ingredient color|餐桌、食物和可透光材料

靜物與生活|Still life & lifestyle|glass|黑卡玻璃輪廓|Black-card glass lighting|用黑卡或窄條白反光板描出透明物體邊界|shape the edges of translucent objects with black flags or narrow white reflections|控制底材透視，不用全白抹去材質|retain visibility through the object rather than filling it with white|透明包裝、杯皿和工藝材質

靜物與生活|Still life & lifestyle|editorial-color|限色棚拍編輯照|Limited-color editorial studio|兩個純色材質搭配背景與輔助道具，讓色階可控|pair two solid-color materials across the ground and restrained props for controlled tonal steps|道具只提供比例或動線，不露假字樣|use props only for scale or visual movement without fake text|封面、品項比較與色彩實驗

時間與實驗|Time & experimental capture|motion-pan|平移追焦|Panned motion capture|在較慢快門下跟拍，主體部分清楚，背景沿移動方向拉線|follow the subject with a slower shutter, leaving part of it sharp and streaking the background along motion|模糊方向一致，不用徑向縮放模糊代替|keep smear direction coherent rather than substituting radial zoom blur|車輛、街道與移動中的生活

時間與實驗|Time & experimental capture|freeze|高速閃光凝結|Short-flash motion freeze|用短閃光時間凝住碎片、液滴或動作邊線|freeze fragments, drops or action edges with a short flash duration|讓動作瞬間合理，避免影隨物反方向|hold a physically plausible instant with shadows consistent with light|動態細節與破裂飛濺

時間與實驗|Time & experimental capture|intentional-blur|刻意移動相機|Intentional camera movement|曝光中控制掃動相機，讓亮部與暗部形成連續筆跡|move the camera deliberately during exposure so luminosity forms continuous brushlike traces|保留一個辨識錨點，讓模糊有單一方向|keep one identifying anchor and one dominant blur direction|抽象旅途與速度感

時間與實驗|Time & experimental capture|double-exposure|雙重曝光疊影|Double-exposure overlay|把第二次曝光排入前一層暗區，避免所有區域均勻重疊|place the second exposure inside shadowed areas of the first rather than overlaying every area equally|兩層輪廓可辨，避免變成普通透明拼貼|keep both outlines legible instead of a uniformly transparent collage|一張圖中的兩段時間或物件

時間與實驗|Time & experimental capture|pinhole|針孔低解析成像|Pinhole exposure|以針孔成像感的全幅柔銳、淡暗角和慢曝時移建構|use soft edge-to-edge resolution, subtle vignetting and slow-exposure motion associated with a pinhole|線條軟而正直，避免魚眼式扭曲|keep straight lines soft but straight, without fisheye distortion|長時間凝視與靜態風景

時間與實驗|Time & experimental capture|projection|表面投影攝影|Projected-image photography|將圖形投到實物表面，讓亮度與透視沿表面轉折|project a visual shape onto a real surface and let brightness and geometry follow changes in angle|用少量環境光保留投影以外的真實紋理|use mild ambient fill to retain real texture outside the projection|多層光影實驗與3D表面
